Definition: a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute
BiblicalUsage: tᵉrûwmâh is the word for a sacrificial offering. In Exodus 25:2, that they bring me an offering. Wherever it appears, the word means this and not something vaguer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe what I lift up to God is never wasted, because He receives what is given in faith. That is why I come back to tᵉrûwmâh whenever I need to remember what is true.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
